review: DAENEM Staff Portal Theme and Sign-In Studio governance review

findings.summary: Aggregate Settings permission allowed a company-scoped administrator to mutate Group-wide theme and sign-in configuration.
findings.correction: Global Theme and Sign-In Studio mutations now require an explicit Owner or Group Admin role plus Settings manage permission.

findings.summary: Personal theme, sign-in configuration, AI copy generation and Group theme policy actions lacked complete audit evidence.
findings.correction: Each state-changing or governed AI action now records bounded audit metadata without prompt or credential content.

findings.summary: Group theme policy writes and their audit evidence were not atomic.
findings.correction: The normalized planned policy and its audit record now persist in the same D1 batch.

reviewer.result: PASS for the bounded Theme and Sign-In Studio governance change; Workflow and Report builders plus authenticated V45 browser acceptance remain pending.
